changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpatientprescriptions AS SELECT pp.id, pp.patient_id, pp.encounter_id, pp.prescription_num, pp.prescription_date, pp.urgency_level, pp.status, pp.from_facility_id, pp.from_department_id, pp.to_facility_id, pp.to_department_id, pp.submited_by, pp.submited_date, pp.created_by, pp.created_date, pp.last_modified_by, pp.last_modified_date FROM public.patient_prescriptions pp;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpatientprescriptions TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpatientprescriptions FROM report_user;
